summary: A future at Depth (client a) and Quote (client b): an OI packet before the first full packet publishes nothing; after it, a circuit packet and an OI packet each republish the last full packet with only their own fields changed, never a zero price.

notes: Prices, the band 1350/1650 and OI 777 from the web tests; the book and OI 700 on the full packet are added, and each partial has its own packet time.

desktop-decision (lead 2026-11-09): client b's Quote subscribe beside a's Depth leaves the instrument's highest mode at Depth, so the desktop sends the broker nothing; the web's adapter calls subscribe_scrips on every subscribe and unsubscribe while a mode remains, and its client sends a second subscribe at ALL here. The desktop coalesces holder changes and never sends again a subscription whose effective mode is unchanged, which is safer under brokers' subscription rate limits; the only effect is that a new client gets its first frame at the next tick rather than at once. Live check: how long a new client waits for its first frame on a quiet instrument.

deviations.reason: HDFC Securities sends lastTradeTime in epoch seconds (the web's own test pairs lastTradeTime 1700000000 with packetTimestamp 1700000000000); the web sends it unconverted as ltt, a docs key that is epoch milliseconds (docs/prompt/websockets-format.md). The desktop converts it to ms (investright::trade_time_ms). Lead decision: ltt in seconds -> ms, web defect (wrong unit).
